The following events took place in '''11,100 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Inquisition]]s begin to take place in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*Following talks with the [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]], the Jedi Order ends its period of isolation, known as the [[Recusal]], and begin to move against the [[Pius Dea]]-controlled [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="EGW" />

==Sources==
*<!-- 2012-04-03 -->''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''
